enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to side. Place hands under pillow. Remain motionless. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and using the toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with toast and tea, cleaning up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread. Take out butter. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Boil water in kettle. Pour water into cup. Add tea bag. Remove toast from toaster. Spread butter on toast. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Stand up. Wash dishes. Wipe counter.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed in work clothes and doing the morning stretching routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Raise arms. Bend forward. Touch toes. Twist torso. Stretch legs.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting up the workstation, reviewing the patient schedule and replying to work emails, working from home because of the transport strike
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to study. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Turn on monitor. Turn on desk lamp. Open email program. Read emails. Type replies. Send emails. Open patient schedule. Review schedule. Make notes.

enriched_activities.activity: Conducting telehealth physiotherapy consultations and guiding patients through exercise programmes remotely
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open video conferencing software. Start call with patient. Greet patient. Discuss symptoms. Demonstrate exercise. Watch patient perform exercise. Correct posture. Provide feedback. End call. Take notes. Start next call. Repeat.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating lunch, washing the dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Chop vegetables. Cook lunch. Eat lunch. Wash dishes. Dry dishes. Put away dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short break, resting and checking the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Browse social media. Read news. Put down phone. Close eyes. Rest.

enriched_activities.activity: Afternoon telehealth sessions, writing patient documentation and designing rehabilitation plans
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Start video call. Conduct session. End call. Open document. Write notes. Save document. Open rehabilitation plan template. Design plan. Save plan.

enriched_activities.activity: Unwinding after work with a snack and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Pick up snack. Eat snack. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put down snack.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on water heater. Undress. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, tidying the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Chop vegetables. Cook dinner. Set table. Eat dinner. Clear table. Wash dishes. Dry dishes. Put away dishes. Wipe counter. Sweep floor.
Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Turn on TV. Open streaming app. Select show. Watch show. Adjust volume. Pause show. Resume show.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading professional physiotherapy journals and completing continuing education modules
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to study. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open journal. Read article. Take notes. Open computer. Log into continuing education module. Complete module. Submit answers.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa, browsing the phone and listening to music
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Open music app. Play music. Browse phone. Scroll through social media. Read articles. Put down phone. Listen to music.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine, brushing teeth and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down in bed, setting the alarm and reading briefly
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Get in bed. Pick up phone. Open alarm app. Set alarm. Put down phone. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Close book. Put down book. Turn off light. Lie down. Close eyes.
Lie down on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Turn to side. Remain still. Sleep.
